objective: Measure the current expanded-Stream-B factor-wise Title/Keywords/Abstract union without requiring all factors in one metadata field.

date_window.source_scope: inclusive ARC months before exact-day exclusions

metadata_route.atom: META(s) = Title(L(s)) OR Keywords(L(s)) OR Abstract(L(s))
metadata_route.factor_rule: Rebuild each protocol Boolean expression from META atoms.
metadata_route.source_execution: ARC rows are AND clauses, so the outer field OR is a stable-ID union over every field assignment. Factors assigned to one field are grouped with explicit AND in that row.

capture.mode: non-mergeable complete preview when each cell is at most 100
capture.stable_identity: normalized DOI before an ARC virtual-collection @ suffix

acceptance_checks: Every cell receives exact source-observed field-row readback.
Every cell total is at most 100 and its preview retains the complete DOI sequence.
Every JSON has both mandatory sibling screenshot files and matching hashes.
Every partition union reconciles raw events and normalized DOI identity.
The current BC1 known eligible sentinel is retrieved.
The complete Pilot 005 BG1 Anywhere set supplies a direct observed-loss comparison.
